chapter_note: Chapter is dominated by cosmological substrate teaching. The opening frame (Apostle seated with disciples + question + disciples' response) is clearly editorial dialogue framework, but the question itself surfaces substantive cosmological terminology (great garments, pearl-ornaments, cluster-pieces, icons, robes of Rhōph-work, cross/element of light, crucifix of light, counsel of life, soul afflicted-slain-strangled-dead within the Enemy). The teaching that follows (i=26-82) is dense, systematic correspondential mapping: garments → five noeric ones → Pillar of Glory/Perfect Man/Ambassador/Jesus; pearl-ornaments → Living Power; three great garments → wind/fire/water → Living Spirit upon Omophoros; element → that which gathers from below; Cross → Power of Light bound; Counsel of Living-One → Call and Hearing; soul → power of fruits/seeds. The editorial seam is the framing, not the content. Damage ratio is high (54%) which limits some readings. Concluding section (i=73-82) about names being one in the first substance is also pure cosmological substrate.
